items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1962-01-04
items.q: I used to like Bruce singers like Ava Walsh, Mamie Smith.

ctx.x: Who were some of the people that you liked to listen to on records?
I used to like the Bruce singers, I used to like, I used to like Bruce singers like Ava Walsh, Mamie Smith.
Did you like the Karnath players on those records? Oh yeah. Jim Noon.
